intended_application: Low-stakes creative slogan and campaign-idea generation for internal brainstorming
business_need: Generate a larger variety of early-stage campaign concepts quickly
capabilities_constraints: Small technical team; access to general-purpose generative AI tools; final client-facing claims and copy receive human review
risk_consequence_context: Low to moderate for internal ideation; higher only if factual product or brand claims are later used without review
management_question: Should the agency build RAG into its creative-ideation workflow, or is a simpler generative baseline sufficient for this use case?
additional_context: Hold the technology constant and test whether the Creation Agent changes contextual relevance without rewriting the general RAG creation history.
